SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 0) - COALESCE(SUM((SELECT SUM(rt.refund_amount) FROM returns rt WHERE rt.order_item_id = oi.id)), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT name FROM (SELECT cat.name AS name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, cat.name) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY cat.id) WHERE rn = 2

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id ORDER BY (r.rev - COALESCE(f.ref, 0)) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Tabuk' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Snacks' AND p.active = 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-12' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-12' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.id) WHERE h24 > 0 AND h25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (h25 - h24) / h24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY c.segment) ORDER BY avg_units DESC, segment LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at < '2024-07-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01')
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Tabuk' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT name FROM (SELECT cat.name AS name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, cat.name) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY cat.id) WHERE rn = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND substr(opened_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2025-04' AND '2025-06'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'high' AND substr(opened_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09'
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Rabigh' ORDER BY e.name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) >= 3 AND (SELECT AVG((julianday(t.closed_at) - julianday(t.opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND t.closed_at IS NOT NULL) > (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'wholesale' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04', '05', '06')

SELECT name FROM (SELECT c.name AS name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY c.id) WHERE rn = 2
